output.summary: A genus of flowering plants native to the Americas and cultivated worldwide for edible fruits known as peppers. Its fruits vary greatly in colour, shape and size. Most species produce capsaicin, causing a burning sensation, although the bell pepper cultivar of Capsicum annuum has none.
output.edibilityNote: The fruits can be eaten raw or cooked and may also be dried, pickled, frozen or made into sauces.
